description: This source file defines a utility function named 'shapeStackedSeries' that processes an array of cost records into a dataset suitable for charting with Recharts. It aggregates raw data by service and category, filling missing categories with zeros, and sorts the categories and services based on options.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a dataset for stacked series visualization, aggregating costs by specified category and service, and applying sorting options.
